gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds prints Water, Sewer and Sanitation columns; no business-type lines in detail[]. Printed revenue rows: Water Charges for services 169,991 + Interest income 246; Sewer Charges for services 62,236 + Interest income 2,553; Sanitation Charges for services 46,301; sum 281,327 (= p7 Total 278,528 + 2,799). JSON receipts 284,493 also hold 'Other miscellaneous revenues' 3,166, which is printed only in the government-wide Statement of Activities business-type column (p2), not in any fund column on p7 (p7 Water operating income 73,032 includes it, but no row prints it). Adding it to a fund would be a derived attribution, so it is not added: after the additions the schedule is 3,166 below the statement, caused by that p2-only statement line.
